mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a temperature of 74 degrees with light drizzle by the Military Ridge State Trail and a moderate air quality index of 53.

The city recently unveiled the Tai Chi Animal Frolics sculpture at Century School Park, a project featuring wood carvings by local artists Gene Delcourt and Christian Felland. Additionally, the Senior Center is encouraging residents to stay active with their various exercise programs, including pickleball and treadmill sessions overlooking the trail.
We have a busy schedule with Yoga at Insight Wellness today, followed by Hop Haus Trivia tonight. Looking ahead, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard tomorrow.

On August 30, officers responded to a call on North Edge Trail where a vehicle window was intentionally smashed. The suspect, who was on probation, fled the scene and remains the subject of an active warrant.
It is a great day to stop by Culver's for the Snickers Swirl flavor of the day. The restaurant is open and serving guests until 10 PM tonight.
